name: IELTS Platform
summary: An IELTS preparation platform with timed full mock tests, practice for all four skills, AI feedback for Writing and Speaking, and tools for managing tests and students.
problem: IELTS coaching centres often run mock tests on paper, which takes hours to mark and makes it hard to see where each student needs more practice.

features.title: Timed full mock tests
features.description: Take full mock tests or practise Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking individually.

features.title: Writing and speaking practice
features.description: Write essays with a live word count and record spoken responses to IELTS-style prompts.

features.title: Estimated band scores and feedback
features.description: Review results and progress by skill. AI evaluation provides feedback and estimated band scores for writing and speaking practice.

features.title: Test authoring and administration
features.description: Create tests and question sets, manage answer keys and media, and review student activity and assessment analytics.

features.title: Coupons and redemption reports
features.description: Set up coupons and review redemptions from the admin portal.

audience: Students preparing for IELTS on their own
description: Students can practise Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking separately or take a timed full mock test. The student portal tracks results by skill and provides AI feedback and estimated band scores for writing and speaking practice. Staff can build tests, manage question sets and media, review student activity, and track coupon redemptions.
